answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 150165 Country: India Title: Can I keep my son's name as Mohammad? Question: Can I keep my son's name as Mohammad? Answer ID: 150165 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 625/512/D=7/1438) Yes, Muhammad name is a blessed one. You may keep it.
